correctness.rationale: Exact coarea support calculation yields every cut halfspace. A circular bit-transition lemma classifies cut sizes; exact radius minima identify all active constraints. These force the center subspace. Sharp singleton and near-balanced interval bounds are necessary, and convex interval-slack plus global mb<1 prove sufficiency for all other cuts. Central-section vertices have a complete exact enumeration. Reproducibility script checked all cuts n=6..16 and all center-vertex inequalities n=8,10,12,14; finite tests supplement the analytical proof.

broader_coverage.reasoning: The general weighted graphical-zonotope result implies the scalar inradius but expressly leaves optimal-center multiplicity and geometry open. Approximate containment theorems do not determine the exact locus. Thus neither stronger statement implies the center classification; the radius is credited as known.
